name: TC-VA-001 — 归档基准包页展示 [P0]
description: 验证ARCHIVED状态默认进入归档基准包tab，展示最终通过图组、弃用清单、基准包信息
page: 迭代详情-归档基准包 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const activeTab = document.querySelector('.ant-tabs-tab-active')?.textContent.trim(); const text = document.body.textContent; const hasPackageId = text.includes('基准包') || text.includes('Package'); const hasPassedGroups = text.includes('通过图组') || text.includes('最终通过'); const hasDiscardList = text.includes('弃用清单') || text.includes('弃用'); const hasArchiveTime = text.includes('归档时间'); const hasAppStatus = text.includes('应用中'); const isReadonly = !document.querySelector('button[class*=discard], [class*=审核操作]'); return { activeTab, hasPackageId, hasPassedGroups, hasDiscardList, hasArchiveTime, hasAppStatus, isReadonly }; })()
steps.description: 验证归档基准包页展示

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 进入迭代详情
2. 验证默认进入归档基准包tab
3. 检查基准包信息展示
4. 验证只读不展示操作
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. ARCHIVED状态默认进入归档基准包tab
2. 展示基准包ID/版本、来源迭代、归档时间/人
3. 展示最终通过图组和弃用清单
4. 当前应用基准包展示应用中标签
5. 只读不展示审核/复核/补拍操作
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/视觉归档
